name: tool-selection
description: Tool catalogs where the correct safe tool must stay selectable after compaction; dropping it while a mutating/destructive tool stays visible is scored as an unsafe-tool error.
disclaimer: Cases are synthetic and self-authored — not sampled from, or submitted to, any external benchmark. The public benchmarks below are referenced only as task-category analogs so readers can anchor the tool-selection and safety task; these numbers are not scores on those benchmarks.

related_benchmarks.name: Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard
related_benchmarks.note: Measures whether a model selects and fills the right function from a catalog — the selection step our safe-tool cases stress under compaction.

related_benchmarks.name: τ-bench (tau-bench)
related_benchmarks.note: Tool-agent-user loops in retail/airline domains with real mutating actions; motivates our unsafe/destructive tool distractors.

related_benchmarks.name: ToolBench / ToolLLM
related_benchmarks.note: Large multi-tool catalogs where the right API must be picked from many — the catalog-size pressure our compaction faces.
